resources.string: Saathi helps your parent use their phone, one spoken step at a time. Setup takes 2 minutes.

Saathi reads the text on the screen and takes a picture of it only when the Help button is pressed or while it is guiding a task. Common tasks are guided on the phone itself. Otherwise these are sent to Saathi\'s server to decide the next step and are not stored, except that the step given for a screen of a shopping or settings app may be kept for a few days, with nothing that identifies your phone. Saathi never taps anything itself, and it cannot see PIN or payment screens.
In Settings, open \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed apps\", choose Saathi and turn it on.
If the switch is greyed out, open App info, tap ⋮ at the top and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
In any app, press the blue \"Help\" button and say what you want to do. For example: \"I want to order milk on Blinkit\".
I could not hear you. Press Help and speak again.
The internet is not working. Please try again in a little while.
First, please allow the microphone for Saathi.
Careful! This app lets a stranger control your phone. If someone on a call asked you to open it, close it now and call your family.
This part you do yourself. Never tell this number to anyone, even on the phone.
You are on a call. If anyone asks for an OTP, PIN or money, cut the call now. Press Help again after the call. To hear better, press Speaker on the call screen.
Another app is using the microphone. Close it and press Help again.
To understand you I need the internet. Turn on mobile data or Wi-Fi, or ask your family to download offline speech.
This phone cannot listen yet. Ask your family to install or update the Google app.
Hold the phone near your mouth and speak a little louder. Press Help and try again.
Saathi is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
You have asked many questions today. Simple tasks still work; for others, please ask again tomorrow.
Saathi looks at the screen and tells you out loud what to press next. It never presses anything itself.
Hello, I am Saathi. I will help you, one step at a time.
This phone has no voice for this language yet. Install it so Saathi can speak.
Heard it? Then the voice is ready.
Download speech for use without internet
Downloading. Keep the phone on Wi-Fi.
Saathi needs to see the screen to point at buttons. It never presses anything.
Saathi listens only after you press the Help button.
